instruction: look at dome_pocket.step. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Use T1 for 3D Pocket roughing and use T2, a ball end mill, for 3D Surface or equivalent surface finishing on the spherical region. Roughing must leave 0.3 mm stock and finishing must target zero stock. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm end mill for 3D Pocket roughing leaving 0.3 mm stock; T2 is a ball end mill for 3D Surface finishing. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: task-15.nc.
